title: Release pipeline: tick and verdict: a release moves on as soon as its before-and-after look is in
why: #317 and #318 (2026-11-27) each waited an hour between their before look and staging. Two causes. First, releases_tick's cron line on live reads */24 (the live read of Scheduled tasks, 2026-11-27 05:50 UTC), while Scheduler::JOBS sets it every 10 minutes and the before-and-after check's design counts on that (handoffs/piece3-check.md §3: "releases_tick (every 10 minutes)"; research/launch-plan-jan1-2026-11-26.md, item 2). Second, the site's read of the verdict file (raw.githubusercontent.com) came back empty from :00 until the late re-ask at 60 minutes, though the file was on main from 05:07:26 (run 45942037912); the job logs nothing, so the wait didn't say why. The fix, as the session manager ruled (2026-11-27, its own release, not the Scheduler bundle): (a) releases_tick puts its own line to every 10 minutes once (BeforeAfter::tickLine, through Scheduler::change's '10min' preset); a later Change on Scheduled tasks is a person's and stays. (b) one advance at a time (a lock), and a release's waiting is cleared only once its verdict is decided, so a step that throws leaves it waiting for the next run, never on staging with nothing waiting for it. (c) the verdict is read through GitHub's contents API on main (DocsRepo::now, with the key; raw only when the API is away), and a release whose verdict isn't there 30 minutes after it was asked says so once on its card, naming the file. Backend only: nothing a visitor sees changes. Reviewed: Tier 4 clear (the CEO, 2026-11-27; it's the launch plan's A.2) and Design: approved (words only). A run that arrives while another holds the lock skips: it returns no line, writes nothing and never errors, and the next run takes it. The 30-minute note has no link to the look's run: the run is named only in the verdict file, which is what's missing when the note is written. Also (the CEO's Tier 4 condition on the check's far-timeout fix, 2026-11-27): a verdict's slow pages reached only through a shared file (its far list) are written on the release's card, at most three, in the Design reviewer's words (2026-11-27): "Before-and-after check: /admin/crawler-review.php (as the test Executive, at 390) timed out, then opened when tried again. Staging is slow there; it's reached only through website/js/tv-ask.js. The IT Manager's lane has it.", or, slow before too, "… was slow before this release too, and still didn't open after it. … The slow-pages ticket has it." A block isn't one (its block says it); Site health's notes aren't copied there. Design: approved with that wording. The ping itself, a widened trust named for the record: /api/releases-pull.php has no secret by design (decisions/0159 §5; Jason, 2026-11-15: any call only makes the site look sooner), and since #314 a web call with no staff session is nobody, so every ping was refused ("not taken: Sign in with your staff login first", fromUpload's need('releases.publish')) and every release waited for the job's next run. Releases::asPing() carries releases.publish, and nothing else, for its one fromGit call, dropped in a finally even when it throws: it takes only builds already merged into main, listed by DocsRepo with the token, nothing from the request, at most once a minute; it never schedules, approves, publishes past staging's checks, turns off, rolls back or moves a verdict on (those stay with the 10-minute job and people). Tier 4 review: CEO, 2026-11-27 (a repair of #314's fallout, Prior Ruling Check yes). The #314 re-audit (the CEO, 2026-11-27) found no other web entry point regressed: every webhook and token endpoint reaches none of the guarded checks.

changes.what: A release waiting for its before-and-after look moves on within a minute or two of the look's verdict, instead of at the next run up to an hour later
Scheduled tasks: Releases runs every 10 minutes (it read */24)

A release with no verdict 30 minutes after its look was asked says so once on its card: "Waiting for its before look: no verdict file on main yet (site-audit/results/beforeafter/N.json), asked N minutes ago"

A release's card says which slow pages the before-and-after check tried again: "Before-and-after check: /admin/crawler-review.php (as the test Executive, at 390) timed out, then opened when tried again. …"

checks.tickverdict: tools/piece3-tests/tickverdict.php 31 on MariaDB: (c) the contents API read on main, decoded; a 404 is null and raw isn't asked; the API away or with no content: raw's fresh read; .. refused; verdict() through it. The note: none at 10 minutes, once past 30, on the card's line, nothing else moved. The lock: a second advance does nothing, then goes on, the lock let go. (b) the real releases-pull.php in its own process: nothing new in main takes nothing and changes nothing, the waiting release untouched, no verdict read, GitHub asked only for the inbox; a second ping in the minute 429 too_soon. Never on staging. (a) */24 changed to every 10 minutes through the '10min' preset, remembered with what it was; a person's later change stays; already */10 only remembered; cPanel not connected: waits, not remembered. The slow pages on the card: the reviewer's sentence once for opened, its own for slow before too, a block's and a bad entry left out, Site health's notes not copied, then the verdict as before (c) the ping carries releases.publish only while it takes builds, never schedule, turn off or roll back; nothing granted after, even when its step throws.
